label: Period Medium
description: How the era's own cameras and film rendered the world — the look people read as 'from then' before they read anything else. Periods covered: the roaring twenties, the great depression and wartime nineteen-forties, the nineteen-fifties, the disco era seventies, the eighties, and post apocalypse, and the grunge nineties.

items.name: orthochromatic-plate
items.text: the look of an orthochromatic plate — skies blown to paper white, reds falling almost black, grain like fine sand

items.name: nitrate-print
items.text: a nitrate print's silvery highlight and deep separated black, edges softening slightly toward the corners

items.name: press-flash
items.text: a single press flashbulb fired straight on, hard shadow thrown onto the wall behind, highlights burnt and corners falling away

items.name: newsreel-grain
items.text: coarse newsreel grain and a slightly unsteady frame, contrast pushed in the developing to survive a bad negative

items.name: kodachrome-saturation
items.text: Kodachrome-era colour: dense reds, clean neutral whites and a fine grain that holds detail into the shadow

items.name: large-format-portrait
items.text: a large-format studio negative — enormous tonal range, shallow plane of focus and detail that survives any enlargement

items.name: faded-print-1970s
items.text: a colour print aged toward warm — cyan gone first, so whites read cream and shadows carry a red cast

items.name: polaroid-instant
items.text: an instant print's soft corners and slightly cool cast, a white border and a surface that shows every fingerprint

items.name: video-still
items.text: the look of a video still — scan lines, colour bleeding across hard edges and a highlight that smears rather than clips

items.name: push-processed-neg
items.text: a colour negative pushed two stops in a hurry, grain opened up and shadows gone green-grey

items.name: scavenged-optics
items.text: an image made through scavenged optics — coating gone in patches, flare crossing the frame, one corner permanently soft

items.name: sun-bleached-capture
items.text: colour bleached toward the ultraviolet end by relentless sun, dust on the sensor printed into every frame

items.name: nineties-point-and-shoot
items.text: shot on a compact point-and-shoot with on-camera flash, a date stamp burned orange into the lower corner and colour running slightly warm
items.text_short: point-and-shoot flash with an orange date stamp

items.name: nineties-camcorder
items.text: shot on a consumer camcorder, interlaced fields combing on any movement, tape noise in the shadows and timecode in the corner
items.text_short: camcorder interlacing, tape noise and timecode
